description: Source code for the UniXcoder model, a neural network for code understanding and generation, including classes for model architecture, tokenization, sequence generation, and beam search decoding.

classes.name: UniXcoder
classes.description: A neural network model for code understanding and generation, based on RoBERTa architecture with sequence generation capabilities.

classes.name: Beam
classes.description: A helper class implementing beam search decoding for sequence generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UniXcoder model, loads tokenizer, config, and model weights, and sets up additional layers.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts input strings into token IDs with specified mode and padding options.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Converts token IDs back into strings.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Computes token and sentence embeddings from input token IDs.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates sequences from source token IDs using beam search.
